THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Routine titles

Keep titles at 30 characters maximum with no explicit routine CTA or pressure-led offer language.

02

Consent & timing

Check the intended audience, consent, frequency and approved send time. Offer campaigns follow separate review.

03

Email usability

Provide useful alt text, visible links and a plain-text alternative. Keep the message understandable when images are blocked.
